req_a.text: The system shall always stop the vehicle to prevent collision with objects during the parking maneuver.

req_b.text: The system shall abort the automatic parking procedure immediately if an unexpected obstacle enters the trajectory boundary within 0.5 meters.

req_a.text: The system shall start identifying available parking spots upon user confirmation.

req_b.text: The system shall allow the customer to select an available parking spot displayed through the HMI with a confirm button.

req_a.text: The APA system shall limit maximum vehicle speed to 5 km/h during automated steering and maneuvering.

req_b.text: The system shall request steering control override permission from the primary vehicle domain controller prior to maneuver initiation.

req_a.text: The APA system shall utilize 12 ultrasonic sensors and 4 surround view cameras to calculate target trajectory.

req_b.text: The system shall verify camera lens clarity and ultrasonic transducer health before enabling parking assist.

req_a.text: The APA system shall signal completion of the parking maneuver via audio chime and electronic park brake activation.

req_b.text: The APA system shall support both parallel parking and perpendicular reverse parking modes.
